channel.title: The Edison log
channel.description: Building Edison, a voice AI chief of staff, in public.

item.title: Whisper vs Parakeet: a real hearing test on a laptop
item.description: I recorded 30 real commands and ran them through two local speech models. One was about six times faster and got every brand name right. Here's the data.

item.title: I built my own AI butler. His name is Edison.
item.description: A solo founder's voice chief of staff that runs on his own PC. He talks back, runs an AI team, watches the house, and asks before he spends.

item.title: What an AI chief of staff actually does all day
item.description: Not a chatbot you visit. A voice that briefs you, hands out work, guards your money and remembers everything. Here's the real job list from mine.

item.title: I can interrupt my AI now. Here's how talk-over works.
item.description: Most voice assistants make you wait until they finish. Edison stops 71 milliseconds after he's sure you're talking, and never acts on what he didn't say.
